title: ESC_ETiX_DD
source_name_ch1: ETiX of ESCs treated with DMSO
characteristics_ch1: tissue: ETiX of ESCs treated with DMSO
extract_protocol_ch1: ETiXs were washed with PBS and dissociated using TrypLE for 5 minutes at 37°C. After dissociation, cells were counted and resuspended in PBS supplemented with 0.04% BSA to a final concentration of 10,000 cells/μL.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Single cell capture and library preparation were performed using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3’ Kit with Chip G (10x Genomics), following the manufacturer’s instructions.
data_processing: Samples underwent quality control and demultiplexing using the Cell Ranger software (10x Genomics).
data_processing.1: Assembly: The mm10 mouse genome was used as the reference for alignment and analysis.
data_processing.2: Supplementary files format and content: filtered feature-barcode matrices, feature and barcode sequences corresponding to row and column indices respectively.
